integrity: Proof by simplex translation, inclusion-exclusion and harmonic binomial sums; exact-rational independent low-dimensional checks are supplementary. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform-simplex null only; threshold first moment, not full joint law or joint tail calibration. Historical priority has residual risk from older specialized spacing-statistics literature. Pearson decorrelation does not imply asymptotic independence.
title: Exact maximum-spacing–Greenwood dependence and a truncated quadratic-spacing law
